text:
As I go to sleep, I think:

tomorrow I will heat the sauna,

pamper myself,

walk, swim, wash,

invite myself to evening tea,

speak to myself in a friendly

and admiring way, praising myself:

Brave little woman,

I believe in you.

translation.title: As I Go to Sleep, I Think
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the self-care list plain and lets the final encouragement stay simple.
